## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Collection area

- [ ] New or updated module
- [ ] Role
- [ ] Fleet or Kibana API client
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or CI

## Checklist

- [ ] I updated module `DOCUMENTATION`, `EXAMPLES`, and `RETURN` blocks where applicable.
- [ ] I added or updated unit tests and integration coverage where practical.
- [ ] I preserved idempotency, check mode, and safe error handling where applicable.
- [ ] I updated the README or changelog for user-facing changes.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks (`just ruff`, `just sanity`, and focused tests).
- [ ] I did not include credentials, tokens, generated files, or private cluster data.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Note any tests that were skipped or
require a live Kibana or Fleet service.

## Additional notes

Include compatibility, licensing, migration, or documentation details.
